good/minimal.why: No narration (microphone denied, explained by an audio gap), one page, one click.

good/dashboard-walkthrough.why: Narrated two-page walkthrough: two transcript revisions with a carried correction, notes with supersede and retract, markers, dwells, a masked input, a cross-origin frame, lost rrweb messages and an audio gap.

good/newer-minor.why: Schema 1.2 from a newer writer: unknown field, kind and gap reason are kept and reported as warnings.

good/two-windows.why: Schema 1.1: the recorded page opens a sign-in popup; marks in both windows, switches between them, the popup closes.

good/stale-agent-export.why: The derived Markdown export no longer matches the bundle; it is regenerable, so this is a warning.

bad/hash-mismatch.why: A file changed after the manifest was written (same size).

bad/size-mismatch.why: A file grew after the manifest was written.

bad/unlisted-file.why: A file is present but not listed in manifest.files.

bad/major-version.why: A different major version is refused.

bad/unknown-kind-same-version.why: An observation kind 1.0 does not define, in a 1.0 bundle, is a writer bug.

bad/window-missing.why: A window observation must name a window documents.json lists.

bad/document-without-window.why: When documents.json lists windows, every document says which window it was in.

bad/wrong-basis.why: A marker must be user-marked; observed and user-marked evidence never mix.

bad/credential-field.why: A credential-shaped field name anywhere outside rrweb.

bad/credential-key-substring.why: A field whose name contains a credential word ("refresh_token").

bad/credential-sk-key.why: A note holds an "sk-" API key shape at the start of a word.

bad/credential-purpose.why: manifest.purpose holds an "sk-" API key shape.

bad/credential-markdown.why: agent/walkthrough.md holds an "sk-" API key shape; Markdown is scanned too.

bad/file-type-refused.why: A file type outside .json, .jsonl, .md and .webm, refused from the listing.

bad/role-unsafe.why: An element role from page markup that is not a role token (it would forge a Markdown line).

bad/revealed-input-while-masked.why: A typed value is present while privacy.inputValues is masked.

bad/excluded-element-named.why: An element in a user-excluded region carries its name.

bad/url-query-value.why: A route URL keeps a query value under urlPolicy redact-query-values.

bad/seq-gap-unexplained.why: An rrweb seq jump with no lost-messages gap.

bad/corrections-overlap.why: Two active corrections cover the same word.

bad/edit-dangling-segment.why: A correction names a segment its revision does not have.

bad/time-outside-recording.why: An observation 4 s after the recording ended.

bad/dwell-too-short.why: A derived dwell shorter than derivation.pointerDwellMinMs.

bad/audio-missing-unexplained.why: No narration audio and no audio gap saying why.
